LUXURY RENOVATED PENTHOUSE – 2 BEDROOMS / 2 BATHROOMS – GORGEOUS PANORAMIC VIEWS NEAR UBC!

Location: Point Grey – At the Gateway to UBC, Vancouver
Experience elevated living in this beautifully newly renovated penthouse, ideally located in the prestigious Point Grey neighborhood, right at the entrance to the University of British Columbia (UBC).
This exceptional 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom penthouse offers spectacular panoramic views of West Vancouver, North Vancouver, Downtown Vancouver, and Mount Baker.
Enjoy breathtaking scenery from both the front and back balconies, with wonderful outdoor space to relax, entertain, and take in Vancouver's beautiful surroundings.
PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS
• Newly renovated penthouse with modern finishes and stainless-steel appliances
• Spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom layout
• Two private balconies – front and back
• Spectacular panoramic views of West Vancouver, North Vancouver, Downtown Vancouver, South Vancouver, and Mount Baker
• Shared free laundry on the penthouse level


Convenient access to UBC campus, shopping, restaurants, parks, and public transportation

BUILDING SECURITY & RESIDENT BENEFITS
Enjoy added convenience, security, and exclusive community benefits at the building:
• Free Secure Underground Parking
• FOB Access System
• Upgraded Intercom System
• Community Garden
• Anytime Fitness Partnership
• Local Restaurant Partnerships
EXCEPTIONAL LOCATION
• Enjoy the convenience of living just minutes from UBC while being surrounded by the beautiful Point Grey community.
• Whether you are a UBC professor, university staff member, visiting academic, professional, or family looking for an exceptional home, this penthouse offers a wonderful combination of comfort, security, convenience, and lifestyle.
• A rare opportunity to enjoy newly renovated penthouse living with spectacular Vancouver views and exclusive resident benefits!
